title: Boston City Payroll
scope: This ledger ranks City of Boston departments on calendar year 2025 earnings (TOTAL GROSS), and also reports the FY26 adopted operating appropriation by department.
exclusions: Does not cover other municipalities (Massachusetts Town Profiles) or statewide payroll (Massachusetts State Payroll).
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from the City of Boston CKAN datastore dump of employee-earnings-report-2025. TOTAL GROSS is summed by DEPARTMENT_NAME. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

SRC-627-02.supports: This ledger ranks City of Boston departments on calendar year 2025 earnings (TOTAL GROSS), and also reports the FY26 adopted operating appropriation by department.

lead: City of Boston earnings totaled $2.46 billion in calendar year 2025 across 25,397 employees (SRC-627-01). Boston Police Department was the largest department at $534.48 million (SRC-627-01). The FY26 adopted operating appropriation was $4.91 billion (SRC-627-02). Boston Public Schools was the largest department at $1.66 billion (SRC-627-02).
